T_tot_def: T_tot = dT_cmblens + dT_tsz + dT_cib per band (kSZ not included)
coords: simulation HEALPix (theta, phi) of the HalfDome lightcone, the same frame for the display images and the value maps; NOT Galactic (l, b)

projection.applies_to: the display JPEGs only (the value maps are HEALPix: value_maps)
projection.coords: simulation HEALPix (theta, phi) of the HalfDome lightcone; NOT Galactic (l, b)
projection.rows: row 0 is theta = 0 (the simulation north pole); theta increases downwards
projection.columns: phi increases to the right from 0 at the left edge (the mirror image of the usual astronomical longitude-increases-left convention)
projection.pixel_centres: theta_i = (i + 0.5) pi / H, phi_j = (j + 0.5) 2 pi / W

display.note: JPEG colour images for viewing only (not for values). _dk = dark-centred diverging variant for overlays. tSZ display shows |dT|.

value_maps.pixel_index: the PNG holds the RING-ordered pixel array row-major: sample k (row k // 2048, column k % 2048) is HEALPix RING pixel k (width = 4 NSIDE, height = 3 NSIDE)
value_maps.lookup: value at (theta, phi) = the sample of pixel ang2pix_ring(nside, theta, phi) (healpy.ang2pix(nside, theta, phi); SkyCore.ang2pixRing in the browser), theta = colatitude from the simulation north pole, phi = longitude, both in the display images' frame; no interpolation
value_maps.format: PNG, 16-bit grayscale, non-interlaced (samples big-endian as in every PNG; rows use the standard adaptive filters 0-4)
value_maps.encode: u = round((clip(v, vmin, vmax) - vmin) / (vmax - vmin) * 65535)
value_maps.clip: vmin, vmax = the 0.05 and 99.95 percentiles of the map's pixels (equal areas, so these are sky-area percentiles); clip_frac = sky-area fraction outside [vmin, vmax]
value_maps.pixel_value: PROVISIONAL (v1-derived): the v1 8-bit value of the sharp l <= 3000 field (nearest NSIDE-1024 pixel at each 4096x2048 grid centre, Lanczos-downsampled to 1024x512, ~21 arcmin), decoded with a half-level bias correction and averaged onto the NSIDE-512 HEALPix pixels (the v1 cells taken as constant; mean over the 64 NSIDE-4096 sub-pixel centres of each pixel); no smoothing

resolution.effective_def: Gaussian-equivalent (second-moment) FWHM of the 2 arcmin instrument beam and the pixel average: effective_fwhm_arcmin takes the pixel as a square of the same area, sqrt(beam^2 + (8 ln 2 / 12) area); effective_fwhm_axes_arcmin gives [minor, major] from the second moments of actual pixels (pixel_fwhm_axes). The l <= 3000 taper is not included.

taper.why: kept at l = 2500-3000 for the NSIDE-512 value maps. (1) It is the field the display images show, so eye and ear get the same field (the ear its 6.87-arcmin pixel means) and one NSIDE-2048 synthesis serves both. (2) The pixel mean suppresses higher l strongly: extending to the beam-limited l <= 6000 would add 4.8 per cent to the stored variance of a CIB-143-like map (each pixel changing by 0.20 sigma rms), 0.6 per cent for tSZ- and kSZ-like maps (0.07 sigma), and would need NSIDE-4096 syntheses to keep the area-mean quadrature accurate. (3) A lower taper would remove power the pixel means should contain: 1250-1500 (~2.5 NSIDE, no power above the pixel scale) would remove 36 per cent of the stored CIB variance, 13 (tSZ) and 15 (kSZ) per cent. Power between ~1.5 NSIDE and l = 3000 stays in each pixel mean as pixel-scale structure; nothing is interpolated between pixel centres, so this "aliasing" creates no artefact. (Synthetic Gaussian realizations of the cls_cache.npz spectra, stretched to 1/4 scale, 64 sub-pixels per pixel; 2026-11-13.)

resolution.replaces: v2: 2048x1024 equirectangular cells (10.5 arcmin, narrowing as sin(theta)) of the field smoothed by a 13.2-arcmin Gaussian, effective 15.1 arcmin
resolution.provisional: the provisional maps carry no structure finer than the ~21-arcmin v1 cells: the NSIDE-512 pixels only resample them

value_maps.units: muK, thermodynamic temperature, beam-convolved (2 arcmin FWHM); monopole kept
value_maps.stats: mean_uK, median_uK, sigma_uK (std about the mean) and rms_uK (about zero) are taken over the pixels of the STORED map (equal areas): use sigma_uK for loudness weights. tSZ and CIB have a large monopole (the median is the empty-sky level), so |v - median_uK|/sigma_uK is quiet where the sky is empty. sigma_field_uK: see sigma_field.
value_maps.sigma_field: sigma_field_uK = sqrt(sum_{l>=1} (2l+1) C_l W_l^2 / 4 pi) from cls_cache.npz with the v1 sharp l <= 3000 cut (the provisional maps have no alms); for reference only
value_maps.shared_files: tSZ entries share two files (+y and -y orientation) and differ only in vmin/vmax; decode them like any other entry. The provisional CIB entries share one file (the 143 GHz pattern; each band its own vmin/vmax).
value_maps.v1_clipping: v1_clip_frac = fraction of v1's 4096x2048 grid pixels (unweighted, np.percentile) clipped when v1 built its 8-bit value map: 0.005 for the symmetric maps (|v| above the 99.5th percentile of |v|), 0.015 for the CIB (below the 1st or above the 99.5th percentile). saturated_code_frac_after_downsampling = area-weighted fraction of the 1024x512 v1 pixels whose 8-bit code is still at a limit (sym: 0, 1 or 255; CIB: 0 or 255) after v1's 4x Lanczos downsampling, which averages most clipped pixels with unclipped neighbours; it understates the clipping, use v1_clip_frac
